tenderSchedule.title: Disposal of Sand blocks in Perabe village kadaba Taluk Dakshina Kannada
tenderSchedule.description: Disposal of Sand blocks in Perabe village kadaba Taluk Dakshina Kannada Reserved for Scheduled Caste(SC)
tenderSchedule.locationName: DMG Deputy Director Office Dakshina Kannada

tenderAddress.blockNumber: The Office of the Senior Geologist, Dept of Mine No.18, Ground Floor, Prajasowdha, Padil

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms & Conditions as per attached Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A person shall be a resident of the concerned Taluk for not less than one year and to that effect recent residential certificate shall be obtained from jurisdictional Tahasildar

The person shall furnish the document as proof of having engaged in extraction of sand in coastal area through manual methods (should furnish Sand TP/lease/licence copies)in accordance with the rule 31-ZB of KMMCR (Amendment) Rules, 2026 gazetted on 02-09-2026. (Furnishing of TP of any duration is Mandatory)

The person shall own a stock yard near the river bank or shall have an agreement with the owner of the land to that effect and submit the recent documents (should be furnish RTC and Sketch having minimum 4 coordinates along with distance between stock yard and sand block) for the same. Stock yard land should be free from Agriculture/Horticulture crops/trees.
If Bidder is an Income Tax payer, last financial year Income Tax returns shall be submitted.
